text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the morning of her debut race, Yaeno 
Muteki performed the kata of the Kongo 
Yaegaki style, seeking to calm her mind 
until the appointed time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to that, before the race 
she had a healthy fire in her fighting 
spirit, completely dialed in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And at last, it's time to take on her 
debut race!
